question: Does Percept's runtime improve cost and event quality on its own?
holds_fixed: evidence format (4 frames, longest side 640 px)
suppression window: 30 s (baseline cooldown = Percept rearm_s)
published_dataset: MEVA only; Perception Test runs are diagnostics, never a published comparison

rows.percept: product defaults (6 attempts a minute per stream; each request reserves 2 and is charged the attempts it used: at most 5 requests a minute when each succeeds first time) except rearm_s, standardised to 30 s (product default 120 s)
rows.percept-matched: max_requests_per_min 13: 13 attempts a minute, at most 12 requests when each succeeds first time (chunk5's rate); retries and verification draw on the same budget. rearm_s 30 s; otherwise product defaults
